source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of the exact original XML verse substring, including written/read notes, not a normalized substitute.
source.public_versification_note: Public and Hebrew numbering align throughout Numbers 1–2. All 88 exact original records are hashed, including the written/read annotation at 1:16. Deuel at 1:14 and Reuel at 2:14 are retained. Later book numbering differences require separate mapping.

key_decisions.decision: Unfolds lift-the-head and by-the-skull idioms as a census and individual listing, retaining male scope and both kinship levels.
Preserves the minimum age without adding an upper limit, military eligibility, both census takers and the divisional arrangement.
Keeps Joseph as the parent grouping and both descendant tribes with their separate leaders and fathers.
Retains Deuel as written here rather than harmonizing it to Reuel at 2:14; the difference is noted.
Follows the called form represented by the reading tradition and retains thousands as the organizational term, with its range explained briefly.
Makes firstborn status readable in its own clause while preserving descent, both kinship levels, explicit male eligibility and the individual-count formula.
Preserves Joseph’s named grouping before Ephraim and the full repeated census criteria.
Retains the aggregate numeral exactly; a note identifies the scope and debated interpretation of eleph without changing the arithmetic.
Preserves appointment, the testimony designation, repeated furnishings, carrying, service and encampment as distinct duties.
Keeps both movement duties, repeated Levite subjects and actual death penalty; unauthorized renders zar by service status rather than ethnicity.
Preserves protective purpose, wrath, repeated tabernacle designation and the keep-charge idiom without turning it into a devotional gloss.
